name: chizu
description: Read your Chizu map and suggest topics, to-dos, notes and charts. Every suggestion waits in your Chizu Inbox for you to approve.

interface.longDescription:
Chizu is a mind map of everything you're keeping track of: home, work, family, projects and ideas. Each topic can hold to-dos, a short note, a link and a chart. It's built for people with ADHD, by people with ADHD. You can see the whole picture at once, then make progress five minutes at a time.

With Chizu in ChatGPT, you can ask about your map, search it, check your Inbox and see what you're focusing on. ChatGPT can suggest new topics, to-dos, notes, moves, charts and log entries. It never changes your map directly. Every suggestion waits in your Chizu Inbox, where you approve it or dismiss it, and you can undo anything.

You need a Chizu account. Sign up at getchizu.com.
defaultPrompt: Look at my Chizu map and tell me what I've been neglecting.
Go through my email from this week and suggest to-dos for my Chizu map.
What should I work on next in Chizu?

positive.prompt: Show me my Chizu map and summarise what's on it.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls get_map and summarises the branches under My life: Home, Work, Family, Health and Ideas, with the topics under each.

positive.prompt: Search my Chizu map for Northwind.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search and reports the Northwind account topic under Work and its open to-do, Send the renewal proposal.

positive.prompt: What should I work on next in Chizu?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls get_focus_context and lists the three to-dos Chizu suggests for the next five minutes, with the topic each belongs to.

positive.prompt: Suggest two to-dos for my Q4 launch topic in Chizu.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the Q4 launch topic, then calls suggest_add_todo with two short to-dos and a reason. Says the suggestion is waiting in the Chizu Inbox. The map is unchanged until it is approved in the app.

positive.description: Suggest a note on a topic
positive.prompt: In Chizu, add a note to my Hiring topic saying we want a designer to start by March.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the Hiring topic, then calls suggest_edit_node with the new note and a reason. Says the change is waiting for approval in the Chizu Inbox rather than claiming it was saved.

negative.description: General knowledge question unrelated to the map
Creative writing unrelated to the map
negative.prompt: Write a short poem about autumn leaves.

negative.description: Asks about a calendar Chizu does not hold
negative.prompt: What meetings do I have on my Google Calendar tomorrow?

publication.release_notes: First release: read and search your Chizu map, see your focus tasks, and suggest topics, to-dos, notes, moves, charts and log entries for approval in the Chizu Inbox.
